newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: IPC Korea unit defaults on debt repayment.
newsitem.headline: IPC Korea unit defaults on debt repayment.

text.p: IPC Korea Co, a South Korean subsidiary of Singapore's IPC Corp Ltd, defaulted on repaying 570 million won worth of promissory notes on Wednesday, an official at Korea First Bank said on Thursday.
Officials at IPC in Seoul were not immediately available for comment.

"The company failed to honour the bills by the deadline of the end of yesterday," the official at the bank's branch in southern Seoul said by telephone. He declined to give more details and asked not to be named.
Earlier, an official at the Stock Exchange of Singapore said trading in IPC Corp Ltd shares were suspended pending an announcement.
Dealers in the Singapore market said earlier there were market rumours IPC Korea was in financial trouble.
